nodes.title: [sdk-client S8] fix(plugin-core): let third-party plugin factories participate in discovery
docs(database): make the MySQL Prisma adapter example honest and executable
auth: session list --stream-url default pins localhost:4437 which no longer exists post-#1211
fix(fresh/form): controlProps() is not element-assignable, and Zod 4 constraint derivation misses numbers and regex
scaffold: db seed is a placebo — SELECT 1 plus a success banner, no rows seeded
service: generated by-id handler returns 500 {defined:false} for a missing row instead of a defined 404
prisma-adapter-mysql: adapter class is unexported and has no connection-error hook
fix(docs/exports): repair contracts and Fresh UI reference drift, then wire the regeneration gate
fix(aspire): 'the dashboard is the authority' is unusable for an agent — aspire start detaches in a non-TTY and prints no login token
Epic: Typed SDK client contributions — credentials, transport policy, metadata, and cache-safe extensions
[sdk-client S3] feat(sdk): expose the typed oRPC client-contribution seam
[sdk-client S1] fix(sdk): preserve contract errors through safe() and isDefinedError
[sdk-client S4] refactor(sdk): centralize HTTP method and GET-cache policy
[sdk-client S5] feat(sdk/auth): prove typed credential contributions end to end
[sdk-client S6] feat(sdk): express trace propagation as a general contribution
feat(cli): no verb generates a resource route slice — the typed contract, cache-first loader and withResource page must be hand-copied from init
feat(cli): app-side client/query wiring is a one-shot template with hardcoded names, colliding 'service' cache keys and a no-op invalidation
fix(cli): ui:add page --island emits a useSignal counter and an empty queryLoaders object instead of the advertised data-screen triad
fix(scaffold): the generated /design/components gallery lists 50 of 66 registry items — the whole AI collection is invisible and no gate compares them
fix(scaffold): the canonical island never passes initialDataUpdatedAt, so the loader's cachedAt is computed, displayed and discarded
chore(quality): `quality:scan` cannot see an `any` in an exported type, an unbudgeted allowance, or a docs snippet
fix(agentic): leak-check cannot see orphaned Aspire process descendants, so it reports clean through a real leak
fix(ai/mcp): make pool startup failure-isolated and propagate cancellation
feat(plugin-workers): generated registry cannot consume project job policy metadata
feat(plugin): publish reusable PluginServiceContext host factory
workers: preserve job payload type through definition, registry, and enqueue
feat(fresh/ai): expose awaited durable chat response completion
docs/sdk: getCachedEntry cache-first loader example never revalidates stale entries
bug(sdk): importing defineServices in a browser auto-registers the server KV cache provider
[sdk-client S2] feat(sdk): define NetScriptProcedureMeta without erasing contract errors
[sdk-client S7] feat(sdk): ship locale as the non-auth contribution proof
fix(fresh-ui): /design ships ungated — the defect class RFC 0005 guards against
RFC: Plugin CLI command contribution architecture — one typed mount and generation seam
test(docs): nothing compiles JSDoc `@example` blocks
fix(tooling): quality:gate roots omit published packages, so a green gate is not proof they were scanned
chore(deps): plugin-workers-core and plugins/triggers import plugin-streams-core without declaring it
fix(cli): `emit` is advertised by three deploy adapters but never routed
chore(quality): register the pre-existing quality-allow population so #1378's linked-issue rule can land without a day-one red gate
docs(positioning): establish "NetScript vs …" and "Migrate from …" comparison framework
test(fresh): no capability to assert the deferred coordinator reaches the client bundle
fix(tooling): acceptance-evidence mirror throws on an empty entry list instead of reporting it
fix(agentic): verdict extractor records NONE when the token is a markdown heading
fix(ci): pull_request.base.sha is stale on long-lived PRs, so every gate that computes a range from it silently inspects the wrong changeset
fix(scaffold): omit unreachable provider URL parsers from SQLite workspaces
Fresh partial navigation needs last-intent ordering and remount-safe region identity
AI provider adapter needs a typed OpenAI Responses mapper
Workers durable execution stream should publish typed progress
SDK cache-provider throw should name its module identity when two SDK instances are loaded
test(fresh): defer-island client-bundle test resolves npm:vite over the network, making the package verdict environment-dependent
test(cli): the prescribed `deno task --cwd packages/cli test` is always red
verify(sdk): confirm the published @netscript/sdk JSR landing page shows the canonical query dialect
fix(fresh): managed form silently drops navigation:'document' when mode:'client'
fix(fresh): route-pattern path inference makes unknown params never instead of a compile error
agentic: formal evaluator dispatch helper must emit phase/head and acquire the existing claim
agentic: report refused OpenHands commands to their author and align generation retry across dispatch paths
test(cli): the scaffold emits no dynamic route, so no gate exercises dynamic route binding end to end
tooling: deno fmt cannot verify packages/mcp — a deliberately malformed test fixture aborts config parsing
fix(sdk): cache telemetry evidence validation throws into the data path
fix(sdk): cache namespace cardinality is unbounded because operationId is caller-supplied free text
tooling: acceptance-evidence blocks fail opaquely when the target issue has no checkbox boxes
mcp: the guidance closeScoreGap constant is pinned by no test — a 10x change passes green
docs(sdk): CacheStore.get JSDoc documents a return shape that no longer type-checks
fix(sdk): cache write limits must not fail successful query results

evidence: RFC 0001 Stage 0 (#1348) must accept the RFC and align #1349-#1353 bodies before Stage 1a implements; rfcs/0001-sdk-client-contributions.md:1273-1274.
Stage 1b owner is "selected in Stage 0; do not file in this run"; rfcs/0001-sdk-client-contributions.md:1275.
Stage 2 scope at rfcs/0001-sdk-client-contributions.md:1276 differs from the filed #1349 acceptance in four places; Stage 0 owns the realignment.
Stage 3 at rfcs/0001-sdk-client-contributions.md:1277 reassigns the deprecate-no-op-options scope and makes the oRPC family move a separate decision.
Stage 4 at rfcs/0001-sdk-client-contributions.md:1278 adds scaffold choice and bans the cookie carve-out the issue still records.
Stage 5 at rfcs/0001-sdk-client-contributions.md:1279 reverses the filed acceptance from "ship a trace contribution" to "prove the transport owns trace injection".
Stage 6 is "new child after RFC acceptance"; rfcs/0001-sdk-client-contributions.md:1280.
Stage 7 at rfcs/0001-sdk-client-contributions.md:1281 defines the generic-discovery exit condition the issue body predates.
Stage 1b must initialize NetScriptProcedureMeta "without re-erasing Stage 1a types"; rfcs/0001-sdk-client-contributions.md:1275.
The normative SdkClientProcedureDescriptor consumed by every contribution embeds Readonly<NetScriptProcedureMeta>; rfcs/0001-sdk-client-contributions.md:410-413.
#1352 acceptance reads procedure policy metadata, which #1466 defines.
#1351 Boundaries: "If #1349 lands first, this issue must additionally prove no contribution can reach the method decision."
#1352 is the first dogfood consumer of the contribution chain #1349 creates; #1352 Summary.
Stage 5 proves a property of the seam Stage 2 builds; rfcs/0001-sdk-client-contributions.md:1276,1279.
#1467 ships a contribution through the chain #1349 exposes.
The RFC-added sdkClients-collection half of Stage 7 cannot land until the contribution seam exists; rfcs/0001-sdk-client-contributions.md:1156-1160.
#1467 is the non-auth counterpart proof and reuses the auth dogfood composition order; both edit the same SDK docs page.
#1352 swaps the first-party CLI off raw fetch at the same call sites whose default URL #1243 repairs (auth-plugin-command.ts:87).
#1112 own text: "Until this lands, #1112 example must document only what ships today"; #1293 opening paragraph.
#1357 emission target is the app-side client/query wiring #1355 regenerates.
#1354 resource slice consumes the client/query wiring #1355 owns.
The new verb should generate against a repaired ui:add emission, not codify the broken one.
Widening quality:gate roots to published packages is only safe once the scanner is export-aware and allowances are registered.
#1455 registry payload map consumes the generated-registry metadata plumbing #1451 introduces.
